decisionBox.changed: Midday add worked: the 85.1k floor held (session low 85,239) and price pushed to 86,067 before stalling. ETFs flipped to a 159.7M outflow on Oct 5 and Fear & Greed is 73, so the book trims a slice into the overnight gap for dry powder; not a bearish call. Resting stop advised below 84,500.

overnightRisk: Next report is ~02:00 COT. Asia open and any US-equity gap can drive a move through the thin 84.5-85.2k pocket. Catalysts: Oct 5 spot-ETF outflow of 159.7M breaking a two-day inflow run, Fear & Greed 73 (greed), 1H long/short account ratio 1.18 (longs crowded, downside-vulnerable), daily MACD histogram still negative. Fresh realized liquidations were shorts squeezed at 85.5-86.0k, so there is no fresh long cluster sitting beneath. Support stack 85,240 / 84,979 / 84,516; a resting stop at 84,450 is the protection. Upside: 86,250 then 86,994 reopens the range high.
